result.reason: The added operative insurance covenant satisfies every preferred requirement, including the conditional cyber/privacy coverage. Its E&O and cyber limits also exceed the fallback thresholds. The redline leaves the bankruptcy provision unchanged and adds only directly related insurance terms; specifying that coverage is maintained at Commerce One's expense throughout the term appropriately clarifies the maintenance obligation without introducing an unrelated commercial requirement.
